target_interpretation: Contemporaneous administrative snapshot of active interstate for-hire property-carrier status; not a record-level historical as-of claim.
reference_time_rule: The later of the two dataset rowsUpdatedAt version markers.
skew_rationale: One preregistered UTC day is the maximum tolerated source-publication lag. It is applied before any join or eligibility outcome is inspected and must not be widened post hoc.

admissibility: The frame, manifest, and schema must pass scripts/audit_fmcsa_census.py unchanged.
The manifest dataset_identity.rows_updated_at must equal 1787919159 and its start/end stability check must bind that same value.
The preserved audit must bind the exact frame digest, row count, zero missing dot_number values, zero duplicate dot_number values, and COMPLETE_FRAME_READY_WITH_LIMITATIONS status.
All four artifacts must be repository-owned or have immutable retrieval references and exact SHA-256 identities; mere ignored-path presence is insufficient.

join_contract.key_normalization: Parse Census dot_number and MOTUS usdot_number as base-10 non-negative integers; reject booleans, signs, decimals, non-digits, and empty values; equality is integer equality.
join_contract.census_cardinality: Exactly one row per normalized USDOT number, already required by the complete-frame audit.
join_contract.motus_cardinality: Zero-to-many authority rows per normalized USDOT number; preserve and evaluate every row without deduplication.
join_contract.authority_conjunction: At least one single MOTUS row must jointly satisfy op_auth_type and op_auth_status; predicates may not be combined across rows.
join_contract.execution_gate: Do not join, inspect qualification counts, or freeze eligibility unless every Census admissibility condition and every artifact identity check passes.

prohibited_claims: The reference time is not an event-effective timestamp for either carrier or authority records.
The 24-hour tolerance may not be changed after inspecting join or eligibility outcomes.
A later live Census version may not be substituted under this preregistration.
